basic_details.post_name: Guest Teacher (Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry, Agricultural Engineering)

important_dates.interview_date: To be announced on IGKV website

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for part-time teachers is 40 years. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, and women candidates as per Chhattisgarh Government rules, provided the total age including relaxation does not exceed 45 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | guest teacher: Master degree in relevant subject of Agriculture faculty with least 55% marks (or equivalent grade 6.50 10.00 scales) with good academic record. NET (National Eligibility Test) shall remain compulsory along with one publication in NAAS rated referred journal for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor and equivalent. Essentiality of NET can be waived off for candidates holding Ph.D. Degree done with course work as prescribed by UGC Regulations 2009 and having at least two full length publications with NAAS rating not less than 4.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,200/- to Rs. 1,800/- per working day (Max Rs. 26,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month)
salary_details.guest teacher (ph.d. qualified): Rs. 1,800/- per working day (Maximum Rs. 40,000/- per month)
salary_details.guest teacher (net qualified, without ph: Rs. 1,500/- per working day (Maximum Rs. 36,000/- per month)
salary_details.guest teacher (neither ph.d. nor net qua: Rs. 1,200/- per working day (Maximum Rs. 26,000/- per month)
salary_details.details: Guest teachers are not eligible for any allowances or facilities other than the specified remuneration.

selection_process: The selection process includes scrutiny of application forms followed by an interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.igkv.ac.in to download the prescribed application form.
Fill out the application form completely with all necessary details.
Attach all relevant documents and certificates in support of qualifications and category.

Send the completed application form along with documents either through email to [email protected] or via speed post to the office of the Dean, College of Agriculture and Research Station, Pratappur, Surajpur (C.G.) - 497223.
Ensure the application reaches the designated address or email on or before 23/10/2026.
important_instructions: The appointment is for one year duration or until regular appointment is made, whichever is earlier. Selected candidates must submit an affidavit on a Rs. 50/- stamp paper agreeing to University rules and conditions. Bring original documents and self-attested copies at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates must perform academic, examination, laboratory, and related duties as instructed by the college. Incomplete applications or those received after the last date will be rejected during scrutiny.

faq.question: Q1. What is IGKV Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IGKV Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification by Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya to hire Guest Teachers on a temporary contractual basis for Soil Science and Agricultural Engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IGKV Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 vacancy for Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry and 1 vacancy for Agricultural Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IGKV Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for IGKV Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master degree in the relevant subject of Agriculture faculty with at least 55% marks along with NET or Ph.D. as per UGC/NAAS guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IGKV Guest Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with upper age relaxations up to 5 years for SC, ST, OBC, and women candidates belonging to Chhattisgarh as per state rules.
